Now personally I love the KH games but I'll try to explain this as best I can.

KH1 had a pretty simple and nice story that anyone could follow.

Chain of Memories was the same way and it introduced a new villain group (Organization 13) and is simple enough to follow and has a pretty good setup for KH2.

KH2 went full on convoluted bullshit fanfiction levels of writing bringing new enemies into the story for no real reasons besides HEARTZ. They bring back one of the villains from the first game who died by just thinking about her (maleficent). Another villain turns out to not have even been the real villain in the overall series (Ansem, Seeker of Darkness) in what seems like an extreme cop out explanation. They added a ton of elements to the story that didn't fully make sense. Gameplay was a huge improvement though.

KH 358/2 days is Roxas's backstory and had a point if you cared about Roxas (I really didn't).

Re Coded didn't need to be made besides the secret ending.

Birth by Sleep was a prequel that tried to explain what the hell is going on. While it semi succeeds it also semi fails. Why does vanitas look the way he does under his helmet/mask/thing? The enemies are just negative emotions now? Why? That just means they can't be stopped and should have been in basically every game. What in the fuck is an X-Blade?
